PluginData.Author: Owen de Bree
PluginData.Tooltip: Optional shared profiles, authoritative inventory actions and coordinated automation.
PluginData.Description: Experimental Unified Storage companion for Magnetar. Provides authenticated, revisioned world-local profiles with paging and recovery tools; optional authoritative transfers and rebalance; owner-controlled refinery, component and loadout services; and cancellable idle-assembler-drain jobs. Operator settings use Magnetar PluginSdk. Server mutation capabilities default off and unattended services also require explicit profile-owner opt-in. The client remains usable without the companion. Full multiplayer gameplay acceptance is pending; use a test server first.
